Bug_Title: EI2: May expose internal representation by creating a buffer which incorporates reference to array (EI_EXPOSE_BUF2)
Bug_Details:
This code creates a buffer which stores a reference to an external array or the array of an external buffer into
the internal representation of the object. 
 If instances
 are accessed by untrusted code, and unchecked changes to
 the array would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Storing a copy of the array is a better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is caused by storing a reference to an external array into the internal representation of the object. If instances are accessed by untrusted code, and unchecked changes to the array would compromise security or other important properties, you will need to do something different. Storing a copy of the array is a better approach in many situations.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case changes the first element of the array in the BugExample object from 1 to 10. This change is reflected in the originalArray. However, since the array reference from BugExample is returned by the getArray() method, modifying the array through the reference changes the original array. This is a violation of the rule for exposing internal representation by creating a buffer which incorporates reference to array (EI_EXPOSE_BUF2)
